tasks.issue_text: Orphan extraction cleanup is treating unrelated lone .json/.md files and symlink-shaped artifacts as generated pairs. Make orphan detection conservative so only complete unreferenced extraction artifact pairs are eligible.

Bulk source cleanup can unlink a persisted artifact path even when that path points outside the extraction directory. Contain deletion so repository/source cleanup cannot remove an unrelated external file.

Project documentation analysis is misclassifying syntactically valid Python declarations/imports containing words such as required or forbidden as normative prose. Preserve prose detection without turning Python declarations into policy facts.

The public remove-library-docs operation can be invoked without proving a project-owned storage topology. Make destructive removal require an explicit project scope and fail closed for configless or non-owned storage.

Cancelling a documentation job is not routed through the selected project's local storage topology. Make project-scoped cancellation find and mutate the job in the project-owned job store rather than the fallback store.

Durable failure diagnostics can persist a sensitive value embedded in a syntactically valid exception class name. Ensure exception type identity is safe for durable/public diagnostics instead of trusting identifier-shaped type names.

When vector indexing fails, the durable job result loses the failure operation/type/message/traceback needed for safe diagnosis. Preserve bounded redacted failure evidence while retaining the previous searchable corpus.

Project source-boundary matching mishandles anchored gitignore patterns/negations and an invalid project manifest can silently fall back to a permissive boundary. Match anchored paths correctly and fail closed when project boundary configuration is invalid.
